concept: Respecting your body's limits and recognizing the difference between healthy challenge and real harm
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student faces a realistic situation with pressure (from self, peers, or a coach) to push past a signal their body is giving them
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides whether to push through or respect the limit
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on how to tell the difference between productive discomfort and real warning signs

assessment.success_marker: student articulates a real, specific distinction between healthy challenge and harm, not just a gut feeling
